doc.brief: Asynchronous API to open a uri with an application.
doc.md:
Asynchronous API to open a uri with an application.

`GtkUriLauncher` collects the arguments that are needed to open the uri.

Depending on system configuration, user preferences and available APIs, this
may or may not show an app chooser dialog or launch the default application
right away.

The operation is started with the [`UriLauncher.launch()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.UriLauncher#method:launch) function.

To launch a file, use [`FileLauncher`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileLauncher).

can_launch.brief: Returns whether the launcher is likely to succeed in launching an application for its uri.
can_launch.md:
Returns whether the launcher is likely to succeed
in launching an application for its uri.

This can be used to disable controls that trigger
the launcher when they are known not to work.

get_uri.brief: Gets the uri that will be opened.
get_uri.md: Gets the uri that will be opened.

launch.brief: Launches an application to open the uri.
launch.md:
Launches an application to open the uri.

This may present an app chooser dialog to the user.

launch_finish.brief: Finishes the [`UriLauncher.launch()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.UriLauncher#method:launch) call and returns the result.
launch_finish.md:
Finishes the [`UriLauncher.launch()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.UriLauncher#method:launch) call and
returns the result.

set_uri.brief: Sets the uri that will be opened.
set_uri.md: Sets the uri that will be opened.
